import sys,json,torch
sys.path.insert(0,'historical-codex-workspace')
from runtime_guard import apply_guard
print(json.dumps({'guard':apply_guard()}),flush=True)
sys.path.insert(0,'historical-resources/autoresearch_tasks/repos/distilled_decoding/VAR')
sys.path.insert(0,'historical-codex-models/framework')
from models import build_vae_dd
from train_student import initialize_from_teacher,attach_checkpointing
import torch.nn.functional as F
torch.set_num_threads(4);torch.manual_seed(2001)
vae,student=build_vae_dd(device='cpu',depth=16,shared_aln=False,attn_l2_norm=True)
vae.load_state_dict(torch.load('historical-resources/models/dd1/VAR/vae_ch160v4096z32.pth',map_location='cpu',weights_only=True),strict=True)
teacher=torch.load('historical-resources/models/dd1/VAR-teacher/var_d16.pth',map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
keys=initialize_from_teacher(student,teacher);del teacher
vae.eval().requires_grad_(False);student.train();attach_checkpointing(student)
pairs=torch.load('historical-codex-models/round02/pairs/pairs_00000.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
labels=pairs['labels'][:1];noise=pairs['noise'][:1];ids=pairs['tokens'][:1].long();target=F.embedding(ids,vae.quantize.embedding.weight);k=torch.tensor([5]);x=student.perturb_data(target,k,noise)
with torch.autocast(device_type='cpu',dtype=torch.bfloat16):
 conti,logits=student(labels,x,k)
 loss=F.cross_entropy(logits.reshape(-1,4096),ids.reshape(-1))+.01*(conti-target).square().mean()
assert torch.isfinite(conti).all() and torch.isfinite(logits).all() and torch.isfinite(loss)
loss.backward()
checks={name:bool(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() and p.grad.abs().sum()>0) for name,p in student.named_parameters() if name in ['head.weight','word_embed.weight','n_d_embed.weight','final_layer_conti.linear.weight']}
assert all(checks.values()),checks
print(json.dumps({'diagnostic_only':True,'cuda_available':torch.cuda.is_available(),'cuda_initialized':torch.cuda.is_initialized(),'teacher_inherited_keys':len(keys),'full_depth':len(student.blocks),'output_shapes':[list(conti.shape),list(logits.shape)],'finite_outputs':True,'diagnostic_ce_plus_embedding_mse':float(loss.detach()),'gradients_finite_nonzero':checks,'lpips_training_executed':False,'fid_score':None}),flush=True)
purpose: Detect initialization, output-shape, activation-checkpoint and gradient faults before the long training stage.
